request.raw_text: If edge with bigger radius is considered as top, add supporting structure to the bottom of the frame by offseting inner wall by 2cm with thickness of 0,5cm of the supporting structure all around. This will create step at the bottom of the frame, enlarging bottom surface area. Leave out radii at the bottom edges. Add radii from top, 0,2cm which will create smoothe transition from above. Bottom remains flat.
action_words: consider edge with bigger radius as top
leave out radii at bottom edges
reference_geometry_words: step at the bottom of the frame

aim.primary_aim: Provide the frame with a continuous stepped support at its flat bottom that enlarges the bottom surface area, has no bottom-edge radii, and transitions smoothly from above through 0.2 cm radii.

functional_design_intentions.name: Bottom support
functional_design_intentions.description: Provide supporting geometry around the bottom of the frame.

functional_design_intentions.name: Enlarged bottom surface
functional_design_intentions.description: Enlarge the frame's bottom surface area through the added bottom step.

functional_design_intentions.name: Smooth upper transition
functional_design_intentions.description: Create a smooth transition from the frame above into the supporting structure.

functional_design_intentions.name: Flat bottom
functional_design_intentions.description: Retain a flat bottom without radii along its bottom edges.

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: continuous stepped supporting structure at the bottom of the frame

required_relationships.reference: bottom of the frame, opposite the top defined by the edge with the bigger radius

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: top-side transition between the supporting step and the frame above

required_relationships.reference: supporting step and frame geometry above
applicable top-side perimeter of the supporting structure

targets_to_change.reference_geometry: bottom edges of the frame and added supporting step

targets_to_preserve.reference_geometry: bottom surface of the frame and supporting structure
targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Preserve a flat bottom after the supporting step and upper transition radii are present.

targets_to_preserve.preservation_rule: Use this edge to define the top orientation and preserve it unless alteration is necessary for the explicitly requested transition.
Preserve non-targeted geometry under a minimum-change rule.

geometry.description: A continuous supporting step exists all around the bottom of the frame, with its boundary located 2 cm from the inner wall, a specified thickness of 0.5 cm, and a flat bottom that enlarges the bottom surface area.
The top side of the supporting step has 0.2 cm radii that provide a smooth transition from the frame above.

relationships.reference: supporting step and frame geometry above

geometry.description: The bottom edges remain without radii, and the bottom remains flat.

relationships.reference: bottom boundary of frame and supporting step

functions.name: Support frame at bottom
functions.description: The continuous bottom structure provides support around the frame.

functions.name: Enlarge bottom surface area
functions.description: The stepped, flat-bottom geometry increases the available bottom surface area.

functions.name: Provide smooth transition
functions.description: The 0.2 cm top-side radii smooth the transition from the frame above to the support.

behaviors.name: Distribute bottom support
behaviors.description: The continuous enlarged flat bottom provides support over a larger surface area.

behaviors.name: Avoid abrupt upper transition
behaviors.description: The top-side radii replace an abrupt step transition with a smooth transition from above.

validation_criteria.description: The supporting step is located at the bottom of the frame and referenced from the inner wall by the requested offset.
The supporting structure has the requested thickness.
The supporting structure extends continuously all around the frame.
The radii at the top-side transition have the requested radius.
No radii are present along the bottom edges.
The final bottom surface remains flat.
The bottom step enlarges the bottom surface area relative to the original frame.
The top-side radii provide a smooth transition from the frame above into the supporting step.
Non-targeted frame geometry remains unchanged under the minimum-change rule.

unresolved_requirements.description: The direction and geometric interpretation of the 2 cm inner-wall offset are not stated explicitly.
candidate_interpretations: The support boundary is offset outward from the inner wall by 2 cm.
The inner-wall profile defines a corresponding support boundary at a 2 cm normal distance.

unresolved_requirements.description: The axis or direction represented by the 0.5 cm supporting-structure thickness is not explicitly identified.
candidate_interpretations: The 0.5 cm value is the vertical thickness or height of the bottom step.
The 0.5 cm value is the in-plane wall thickness of the supporting structure.

unresolved_requirements.description: The exact top-side edges that receive the 0.2 cm radii are not identified.
candidate_interpretations: All upper perimeter edges where the supporting step meets the frame above receive the radii.
Only the upper outward-facing edges of the supporting step receive the radii.

unresolved_requirements.description: The request identifies the top through an existing edge with the bigger radius, but no exact model identifier is provided.
candidate_interpretations: The edge having the largest existing radius defines the top orientation.
A comparison between two differently radiused frame edges defines which side is the top.
